title: First videotaped Grusch interview at Bryce's house

tellings.quote: So he came over and we, you know, Dave Crush was in, you know, cargo shorts and a t-shirt for this thing.

plain: The first videotaped interview with David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who in 2023 said publicly that the government holds craft that were not made by humans, was filmed at the Los Angeles home of the television writer and producer Bryce Zabel. Zabel tells Michels he was there and remembers how casual it was: "Dave Crush was in, you know, cargo shorts and a t-shirt for this thing." He says the Australian journalist Ross Coulthart and a man named Jared were part of it too.
